status: Component implemented; catalogue and router integration owned by parent task

completion.outcomeNote: Sample values only. Actual enum/boolean values come exclusively from the user's state; completion means the app flow was finished, not that a real event succeeded.
completion.exit: onAttemptEvent action=exited then onExit; no forced reflection
completion.privacy: No situation, prediction, plan, rehearsal, observation, learning or next-step wording in host outcome or history.state

hostRegistration.resetOption: Add a taraTactician Experience branch and catalogue resolution, forwarding existing ResetFlow callbacks.
hostRegistration.standaloneOption: Register /tara-tactician with a thin host-owned page, normal exit/completion callbacks, and standaloneRouteFor mapping; no iframe is required.
hostRegistration.catalogueOwner: Parent handles catalogue/router/library entry/takeaway/alternatives and associated invariants together.
hostRegistration.existingInvariant: eliteInterventionSystem.test.js expects exactly the existing 18 flagship IDs and checks INTERACTIVE_FLAGSHIP_IDS against them. Mechanically appending Tara only to that list fails the invariant; reconcile through the parent's chosen registration strategy.
hostRegistration.coarseOutcome: Current coarseCompletionOutcome preserves completion, saved and matching interventionId but drops new eventStatus/predictionComparison/rehearsed. Explicitly allowlist those enums/boolean if host history needs them; never spread a full local record.
hostRegistration.brandThreshold: Optional host atmosphere: light pale-aqua surface, teal ink and pink accent; current unknown-ID threshold uses its default atmosphere. Parent owns any brand registration.
hostRegistration.typecheck: Existing jsconfig includes ResetFlow and transitively imported components; parent import provides integration typechecking. The isolated component was also production-bundled separately.

storage.contents: One resumable draft and at most 20 explicitly saved recaps
storage.writeContract: Read-back verified; failed/unavailable storage leaves editable in-memory state and a truthful error
storage.resume: Refresh reopens the saved phase and authored content
storage.delete: Clear Tara data deletes draft and all recaps; existing app-wide deletion covers mentation. and clears mounted Tara state via its event
storage.integrity: Unreadable/future-schema data is preserved until the user chooses deletion
storage.completedRecap: A persisted completionReported flag prevents a normal recap refresh from emitting another completion; saved-recap browsing is review-only. Host session persistence is authoritative if local writes fail.

visualReference.chosenTreatment: Editorial Garamond headings, Hanken interface text, soft ivory/pale aqua surfaces, deep teal/aqua/pink accents, detailed existing Tara artwork occupying approximately a quarter of the mobile heading area. Dark teal is reserved for Tackle/live support.
visualReference.asset: public/media/brand/tara-tactician.webp already exists in base repository; no image edit or new dependency

validation.browser: 9 scenarios: 320px/390px, two selection reveals, optional rehearsal, saved draft refresh, Back after refresh, live support return, six honest comparisons, intentional stepping out, unattempted/unknown action, optional recap save, quota failure, deletion, app-wide deletion, enlarged text, reduced motion, dialog keyboard/focus, no duplicate completed-recap learning
validation.integrationLimit: Host catalogue and final combined app navigation are not registered on this isolated branch and require parent validation.
validation.nativeLimit: No iOS simulator/device run was performed in this Linux executor.

release: Own task branch only; no push, merge or deployment
